changes.before: Jenga Hospitali na umsaidie mfanyakazi aliyejeruhiwa apone. Makazi yanaanza yakiwa na chakula cha kutosha, na mfanyakazi mmoja aliyejeruhiwa.
changes.after: Jenga Hospitali na umsaidie mfanyakazi aliyejeruhiwa apone. Mwanzoni, viumbe wa makazi wameshiba, na mfanyakazi mmoja amejeruhiwa.
changes.reason: The source says the creatures start fed (their hunger satisfied), not merely that the colony has enough food available. That distinction explains why the prepared injured worker needs a Hospital rather than hunger relief. Current chakula cha kutosha changes the starting-state explanation.

unakoelekea means where you are heading. The control reveals the current lesson target/marker (including a building, worker or defense area); it does not inspect the player or a selected unit travel destination. Use an objective-location caption.

changes.after: Chagua mnara na uombe wasambazaji. Subiri angalau mawe 2. Mnara uliokamilika unahitaji uombe wafanyakazi wa kuleta risasi. Idadi hiyo inawekwa tofauti na idadi ya wafanyakazi wa ujenzi.
